newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy August same store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy August same store sales down.

text.p: Best Buy Co Inc said Thursday same store sales for the four weeks ended August 31 decreased three percent.
Best Buy added that comparable store sales rose four percent for the second quarter and increased four percent for the first half of the fiscal year.
Best Buy said same store sales in August 1995 were up 14 percent compared with the prior year.
August 1996 sales of $603 million were 14 percent above last year's $527 million, Best Buy said. Sales for the second fiscal quarter were $1.78 billion, up 24 percent from $1.44 billion a year ago.
Sales for the first half of fiscal 1997 were $3.42 billion, an increase of 26 percent over $2.71 billion for the first half last year.
"Sales comparisons to the previous August were very difficult due to the high level of promotional activity last year in connection with the introduction of (Microsoft Corp's ) Windows 95."
Best Buy, a specialty retailer of electronics, computers and appliances, said it operates 262 locations, 208 of which were considered comparable in August.
